notes: Supplied p. 7 reports the three-group omnibus test, not the described prosocial-versus-competitor pairwise test in sample 2. The original Study 3 pools several surveys/laboratory studies, without a sample-2 result at this locator. The separate prosocials versus both other groups planned contrast appears on p. 740. No exact analytic n printed; do not substitute the pre-exclusion classified count of 544. Source is the published 1997 Journal of Personality and Social Psychology article, pp. 733–746; title and authors match the assigned reference.
